channel.title: JP Drops
channel.description: Japan-exclusive anime & game merch news in English

item.title: New Chiikawa Goods at Chiikawa Market
item.description: New Chiikawa goods drop on the official Chiikawa Market online shop Oct 9 (Fri) at 11:00 JST! Nikuman mascots, drinking goods with Kurimanju, plus new Chiikawa Sushi, Shisa Souvenir Shop & Chiikawa Restaurant Okinawa items. 🌏 Ships overseas via Chiikawa Market's official forwarding service

item.title: On Sale Now: Ichiban Kuji Ghost in the Shell
item.description: Ichiban Kuji Ghost in the Shell is on sale now, rolling out to stores in Japan. Prize A is a large figure of Motoko Kusanagi together with a Fuchikoma.

item.title: OxiClean 1500g Chiikawa Package (Limited)
item.description: OxiClean 1500g comes in a limited-edition Chiikawa package! Release starts Fri, Oct 2, 2026 (JST) at Chiikawa Market, Chiikawa Land, drugstores, home centers and supermarkets across Japan, plus Amazon, Rakuten, Yahoo! and Qoo10. Not all stores will carry it.

item.title: Chiikawa "Parallel World!?" Mascots Pre-order
item.description: Chiikawa "Parallel World!?" Mascots (4 types) are being made to order. Pre-orders open Mon 9/28 at 18:00 JST on the official Chiikawa Market online shop. Free shipping on sets of all 4 (Japan only), no purchase limit.

item.title: Blue Archive Kikyou (Swimsuit) 1/7 Scale Figure
item.description: 🩱 Blue Archive's Kikyou (Swimsuit) is getting a 1/7 scale figure! Maker: Design COCO. Preorders are now open at its official store.

item.title: Pokémon x Starbucks Japan Collaboration
item.description: ☕ Pokémon x Starbucks Japan is here! Starbucks Japan is launching Pokémon collaboration drinks and merchandise. The announcement blew up in Japan: 15.75M views and 91K likes on Pokémon's official Japanese X account. Announced: Sep 25, 2026 (JST) Release dates & prices: see the official page 🛒 Buy from overseas via proxy

item.title: Ichiban Kuji Release Calendar: October 2026
item.description: 🗓️ Ichiban Kuji release calendar: October 2026 (JST, in-store start dates) 10/2 That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (Chokotto) 10/3 Gundam Universal Century Saga 2 10/17 Uma Musume Pretty Derby Vol.14 10/17 Dragon Ball 10/24 Kagurabachi 10/24 Sumikko Gurashi 10/24 Attack on Titan 10/26 Naruto Shippuden 10/29 One Piece 10/31 Made in Abyss 10/31 Fate/Grand Order +9 more, including Fairy Tail & W

item.title: Halloween at Pokémon Center Japan
item.description: 🎃 Halloween is coming to Pokémon Center! Pokémon Center stores across Japan are celebrating Halloween with Pokémon starting Sat, Oct 3, 2026. See the official page for all the details. 🔎 Store/lottery only in Japan — find it later on Japanese resale sites
